subject: START shader-coverage-opus: full corpus replay ledger + AIR->NIR lowering fixes (no source edits yet)
body: Own dir gpu/build/shader-coverage-20261027 (new, mine). Replaying all 7504 kernel AIR + 1883 graphics jobs against CURRENT host libs (bridge d4917c28, Mali 2430cc80, profile gpu/build/tegu-frontend/tegu-air-profile.h) with a fork-isolated harness (nice10, -j<=6). Will claim exact regions in translator (references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin crates/metal2vulkan-air lowering) / mali_graphics_compiler.c NIR lowering before any edit. Not touching render_pipeline.inc, pipeline_cache*, air_bridge.rs plan code, nord2_metal_render.c, nord2_render_pass.inc, compositor_submit.inc, render_encoder.inc. Replay is not a cargo/ninja build; heavy builds will take the lease explicitly.
